newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Anhui Expressway to issue 493 mln H shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Anhui Expressway to issue 493 mln H shares.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Anhui Expressway Co Ltd plans to offer 493.01 million "H" shares at HK$1.77 each, the company said on Wednesday.
The company told a news conference 85 percent of the issue would be placed out and 15 percent would be offered in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
H shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in on the Hong Kong stock market.
The Hong Kong offering will run from October 31 to November 5 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on November 13.
Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd and CEF Capital Ltd are the sponsors and lead underwriters of the issue.
Anhui Expressway owns, operates and develops toll roads in China's central Anhui Province. It currently owns and operates the 134-kilometre Hening (Hefei-Nanjing) Expressway.
The firm forecasts profit after taxation for the year ended December 31, 1996, to be not less than 90 million yuan.
